rw-1ukT.title: Lamp post: arm shape by road colour
rw-1ukT.summary: Lamps are fairly consistent on national roads. Green roads: slightly curved arms extending past the post. Red: shorter arms with a sharper bend. Blue: long arms curving their whole length. Grey roads rarely have lamps.

rw-2JiY.title: Landscape: volcanoes and volcanic rock
rw-2JiY.summary: Volcanoes and volcanic rocks can be seen in the northwest.

rw-2MuC.title: Landscape: dry bushland, wide red-brown dirt roads
rw-2MuC.summary: A national park with green but dry land and wide reddish-brown dirt roads, with rectangular waystones at crossroads. Filmed with the brown Google car.

rw-5bSi.title: Road: cobblestone pavement
rw-5bSi.summary: Many roads in the southern town of Butare have cobblestones.

rw-6v8t.title: Plate: long, white front, yellow back
rw-6v8t.summary: Long licence plates, white on the front and yellow on the back.

rw-840u.title: Motorbikes: red vests and helmets
rw-840u.summary: All motorcyclists must wear red vests and helmets.

rw-G0Ol.title: Plants: tea plantations
rw-G0Ol.summary: Tea plantations are common in the west and a couple of other pockets.

rw-GGAi.title: Lamp post: road number in black letters
rw-GGAi.summary: Lamp posts on many national roads have the road number in black paint, with a lamp number below that usually rises the further you are from Kigali.

rw-Hb5P.title: Landscape: gentle hills, farmland, grassland
rw-Hb5P.summary: In the northeast the land is less extreme: rolling hills with open farmland or untouched grassland.

rw-Hh5T.title: Streets: very clean, no litter
rw-Hh5T.summary: Streets are noticeably clean and free of garbage.

rw-J31h.title: Route marker: white concrete waystones
rw-J31h.summary: Various styles of white concrete waystones.

rw-MTTM.title: Kerb: black and white stripes
rw-MTTM.summary: Kerbs are often painted with black and white stripes.

rw-SBDN.title: Google car: hazy tint, especially in the sky
rw-SBDN.summary: The picture has a clear hazy tint, most visible in the sky. Senegal has similar hazy Gen 4 coverage in Africa.

rw-UOlK.title: Plants: eucalyptus trees
rw-UOlK.summary: Eucalyptus is very common: long, often clumped leaves and smooth bark. Kenya and other countries have it too, so use with caution.

rw-XCdi.title: Houses: luxury villas
rw-XCdi.summary: Much of the capital's coverage is in richer areas with many luxury villas.

rw-Zc2V.title: Road lines: all white on one road
rw-Zc2V.summary: The NR11 north of Mabanza uses all white road lines.

rw-cXjQ.title: Street sign: two-letter district code
rw-cXjQ.summary: Street names often include a two-letter code telling you which district you are in.

rw-fT6w.title: Coverage: limited, mostly one big city
rw-fT6w.summary: Coverage is limited to the capital Kigali and a few other patches. New coverage is released sporadically, so check the current map.

rw-g5Yq.title: Bollard: red and white cylinders
rw-g5Yq.summary: Several different red and white cylindrical bollards.

rw-hmIS.title: Landscape: red-tinted soil
rw-hmIS.summary: Most soil has a noticeable red tint.

rw-jFGS.title: Road lines: dashed white edge lines
rw-jFGS.summary: The NR16 is the only road that mainly has dashed white edge lines. Dashes elsewhere mark intersections.

rw-kgGt.title: Google car: pickup hidden by a big blur
rw-kgGt.summary: All coverage is the Gen 4 camera. In most of it the Google car is a pickup truck, covered entirely by a big blur.

rw-lm-13138.title: Google car: black pickup truck
rw-lm-13138.summary: A black pickup truck is seen in most of the capital. The white car appears everywhere in the country.

rw-lm-13139.title: Google car: brown pickup truck
rw-lm-13139.summary: A brown pickup truck appears in many small pockets around the country. The white car appears everywhere.

rw-mjV9.title: Landscape: hilly but not mountainous
rw-mjV9.summary: Generally quite hilly, but not very mountainous.

rw-pMGj.title: Road: unpaved, under construction, red cliff
rw-pMGj.summary: A long stretch of the NR15 is unpaved, the only national road like that, and mostly hugs a steep red dirt cliff. Other unpaved roads are narrower and busier.

rw-qGPQ.title: Houses: tall security fences and walls
rw-qGPQ.summary: Villa neighbourhoods often have tall security fences and walls.

rw-qx8o.title: Google car: white or brown pickup with brake light
rw-qx8o.summary: Sometimes the whole car is visible: a big white or brown pickup truck with a brake light and the camera mount showing.

rw-rAil.title: Bollard: French-style, green lamp posts in forest
rw-rAil.summary: A lush hilly forest park. The paved NR10 has road lines, French-style bollards and green lamp posts. The NR26 to the south has no road lines. Filmed with the brown Google car.

rw-rl93.title: Road: potholes and no road lines
rw-rl93.summary: The NR15 from Muhanga to the Western Province border has poor pavement, many potholes and no road lines.

rw-vMyW.title: Landscape: wide river on city's northeast edge
rw-vMyW.summary: A wide river runs along the northeastern edge of the capital city area.

rw-w8kf.title: Houses: brick and concrete, ventilation bricks
rw-w8kf.summary: Lots of brick and concrete, mostly single-family houses with fairly steep roofs and protective fences. Many have decorative 'ventilation bricks' with holes in the wall.
